changes.title: Bounded shared-memory broadcast waits
changes.note: PR 800 adaptive spin commit replayed on top of the prefetch commit; recorded as ce5f4148d4. This base uses FlashInfer's CSF source/block APIs rather than the removed CsfScalePlanes API.

changes.title: Advisory disk row-cache prefetch for Qwen4Exp PLE and DeepSeek V4.1 Engram
changes.note: One switch, VLLM_PLE_PREFETCH=1, warms the host row cache ahead of the lookup through the pinned FlashInfer's DiskTable.prefetch and the ple_hash.host and engram.host row-id helpers.

changes.title: Prometheus metrics for the b12x row cache and prefetch
changes.note: Counters for hits, misses, residency, pool bytes and the prefetch queue, served on /metrics by vllm/v1/metrics/b12x_row_cache.py. The b12x caches are sampled on a daemon thread, never on the step path: reading them inline cost a 14 us median and a 3.6 ms worst case against the prefetch worker's lock, where the published snapshot costs 0.6 us. Totals are reported whether or not VLLM_PLE_PREFETCH is set, because the cache serves synchronous lookups either way.

changes.title: Resolve FlashInfer scale-swizzle intrinsics
changes.note: Use intrinsics.reference for NVFP4 and MXFP4 linear weight preparation with the pinned FlashInfer.

changes.title: Initialize pin-memory support after torch helpers
changes.note: Fix the lunar CPU-platform circular import exposed by the image CLI smoke.

changes.title: Rewrite flash_attn.cute imports to vllm.vllm_flash_attn.cute
changes.note: Packaging repair for this builder's symlink install path, which skips the import rewrite the upstream CMake copy performs. It carries no upstream change.

changes.title: C S3-FIFO host row cache for disk PLE/Engram tables
changes.note: Seven PR commits replayed onto main 9c9e94ef9aff as 0a2c4387a, then the caller-gated DiskTable.prefetch and host row-id commits, and four more that add prefetch telemetry to DiskRowCache.stats(): requests, rows queued and dropped, jobs, errors, and rows loaded or cancelled only as the worker really published or released them. vLLM's prefetch hook and its metrics both need the row-cache commit 0b6e5ee8b or later.
